faq.q: What source photo works for a fashion reel?
faq.a: Use a sharp, well-lit photo that shows the full garment and its important details. A flat lay, mannequin or hanger view can work.

faq.q: Can shoppers see the full outfit?
faq.a: Yes. Choose a full-body scene so the silhouette, hem and footwear stay visible. Use your listing for measurements and fit facts.
Use 6 seconds for one reveal, 10 or 15 seconds for a turn or walk, and 30 seconds when the look needs several beats. The cost appears before creation.

faq.q: How do I keep the garment accurate?
faq.a: Compare the export with the source photo. Check the color, collar, closures, seams, print and hem before you publish.

faq.q: Can I use a fashion reel in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Use the downloaded reel in your own TikTok, Instagram, Facebook or other paid campaigns, with any required disclosure added in the platform editor.

faq.q: Do I need to book a model?
faq.a: No. The reel is generated from your clothing photo with an AI model, so you can prepare another outfit scene without a shoot day.

visual.overview: Show one complete outfit in a scene shoppers recognize. A full-length turn or walk makes the silhouette and styling easier to judge than a flat product shot.

steps.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the garment and preserve its shape, color and seam details exactly. An adult model turns once to show the side fit of the beige zip jacket. Use a full-length medium frame with a slow tracking move so the collar, cuffs, hem and shoes stay visible. Soft studio daylight keeps the beige jacket and seams clear. End facing forward with the full jacket centered. Sound: quiet room tone and a light fabric rustle. No music. Keep the final pose steady for a thumbnail and leave safe space for platform controls.
